results.title: [2606.12556] ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with Disaggregated CXL-Hybrid Memories
results.content:
Performance Potential Analysis via CMM. To evaluate the performance potential of the proposed architecture, we developed a production-grade empirical platform integrating an SK Hynix CMM (32) and two KIOXIA PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs (18). To maintain architectural consistency with the FPGA prototype, we utilized 32 GB of the CMM capacity as the DRAM cache. Leveraging the SPDK framework (15) with 8 PCIe lanes (4 lanes per SSD), this setup achieves a peak read throughput of approximately 22 GB/s. [...] Empirical Potential Analysis and FPGA Prototyping: We validate ITME by evaluating its performance potential using production-grade SK hynix CMM (32) and Gen5 NVMe SSDs (18), while further demonstrating functional feasibility through an FPGA-based hardware prototype. Our evaluation shows that ITME achieves a throughput improvement over NVMe-oF-based disaggregated storage baselines in large-scale LLM inference.

## 2. Background and Motivation

### 2.1. Evolution of Inference Memory Hierarchy [...] Functional Prototyping via FPGA. A functional prototype, implemented on an Intel Agilex 7 I-Series FPGA (3), validates the hardware-level control logic and the software prefetcher. This platform integrates 32 GB of DDR4 DRAM as a hardware-managed cache for two SK Hynix Platinum P51 PCIe Gen5 NVMe SSDs (37). This setup establishes the feasibility of our expansion tier, successfully realizing a multi-terabyte, byte-addressable memory footprint by leveraging the cost-efficiency of NAND flash.
